subject: Cross‑functional realignment and QBR alignment — comms & manager playbook
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: cross-functional realignment — comms & manager playbook

Team —

Attached is a first-pass announcement and a short manager playbook for the cross-functional realignment we discussed in last week's leadership sync (reorg_comm_v0.1.docx). High-level: we are consolidating three product squads into two pods (Platform, Experience) to reduce context switching and better align with our throughput OKRs for Q3. This is intended to improve velocity while keeping headcount stable.

Asks:
- Please read the announcement and highlight any phrasing that could be misread as involuntary reductions — we want to avoid words like "eliminated" or "sunset" where possible.
- Review the manager playbook section on timelines and 1:1 talking points. Can we finalize by EOD Friday so Legal/People can review over the weekend?
- I included a stub QBR slide block (bottom) that ties the rationale to our OKRs (throughput, platform latency). Suggest additions for measurable outcomes.

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 3/26: finalize internal announcement + manager talking points
- Mon 3/29: manager cascade and optional drop-in office hours (2x)
- Wed 3/31: company all-hands + QBR alignment notes

I also flagged a short FAQ that I think should be published with the comms (see linked Drive).

Thanks — this will be short and specific rather than a long narrative.

Mina
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: reorg_comm_v0.1.docx (docx, 42KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: cross-functional realignment — comms & manager playbook

On Thu, Mar 25, 2027 at 09:12 Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached is a first-pass announcement...

Nice work — short and sensible. A couple quick thoughts inline:

- Under "What changes": can we be explicit that this is a re-alignment of reporting lines and scopes, not a headcount reduction? We should add one sentence that managers will not be asked to make layoff decisions as part of this exercise.
- For Platform vs Experience: call out which teams migrate (infra, SDK, routing) so folks in engineering see the mapping.
- Add a fallback paragraph for customers who ask impacts on SLAs (two lines) — we should reassure there is no SLA change.

Also suggest adding a short "If you're impacted" section with links to the FAQ and to a dedicated calendar slot for 30-minute manager guidance.

I removed one sentence that used the word "sunset" and replaced it with "consolidate scope" — matches your ask.

Jonas
VP, Engineering

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: cross-functional realignment — comms & manager playbook

Thanks — read through quickly. Two practical edits:

1) Tone: replace "will be eliminated" in paragraph 2 with "will be redistributed" or "roles will be reorganized". We want to avoid language that triggers out-of-cycle resignations.
2) Headcount numbers: don't publish raw headcount in the public announcement; keep those in manager-only notes.

Also, can we include an FAQ Q: "Will this affect my compensation or bonus?" with the simple answer: "No changes to compensation or bonus structure are planned as part of this alignment."

Finally, recommend we push the all-hands one day earlier if Legal says review could take longer; adding a week of buffer isn't bad.

—Karthik
Head of People Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: cross-functional realignment — comms & manager playbook

Quick pass attached (manager_cascade_schedule.xlsx) with suggested manager cascade times by region. A few manager playbook notes I added inline:

- Keep 1:1s to 20 minutes; managers should focus on three things: what changes, what support will be provided, next steps.
- Include a prepared "If they ask" bank of three answers for sensitive questions (headcount, comp, relocation).
- Recommend two office hours windows for Asia teams to avoid late-night meetings.

Also: small ask — can we add a short paragraph for Sales/Customer Success to use externally if customers ping them? Something like: "No impact to service levels — internal org changes to improve delivery speed."

Laura
Chief of Staff

Attachment: manager_cascade_schedule.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: cross-functional realignment — comms & manager playbook

Appreciate the fast reviews — thank you.

Plan: I'll incorporate the wording edits (remove any "eliminate" language, strip headcount from the public memo), add the FAQ items Karthik suggested, and fold Laura's manager cascade schedule into a single sheet. I'll send the finalized manager-only packet to People and Legal by 3pm today and ping PR to prep a one-paragraph external statement for customer-facing teams.

Related: I created a shared Drive draft (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-reorg-draft) and opened HUBSPOT-12345 for tracking customer comms. If there's no objection by noon I will lock the doc and schedule the cascade times Laura proposed.

Mina
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
